name: vito-agent-plugins
description: Vito's personal Claude Code skill collection — planning, clean-context second opinions, context auditing, web/code search, session handoff, and HTML visualization. Bundles 6 skills auto-discovered from skills/, plus 3 subagents (agents/) — a generic general-skills-executor that runs noisy delegated skills in isolated contexts, the clean-context ai-second-opinion reviewer, and the standalone code-search explorer — and a table-driven PreToolUse skill-guard that redirects inline noisy-skill usage to the right subagent.
